The '''Codian Moon''' was a [[Moss/Legends|moss]]-covered [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]]. Featuring [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] and plains of [[Wood-moss/Legends|wood-moss]] turf, the Codian Moon was the site of several [[Farm/Legends|ranches]] used for [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] [[Reek/Legends|reeks]], [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].

Several [[Farmer/Legends|ranchers]] of the Codian Moon began breeding and [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] their reeks for use in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas by [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the moon was not affiliated with either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
The Codian Moon was a terrestrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Codia system/Legends|Codia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] of<ref name="Mid Rim" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The moon was covered by [[Moss/Legends|moss]],<ref name="Monster">''[[Star Wars: What Makes a Monster?]]''</ref> with its terrain features including mossy [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]<ref name="NEGAS" /> and rolling plains of [[Wood-moss/Legends|wood-moss]] turf.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
[[File:Reek_SWCT.png|thumb|right|300px|Reeks were bred on the Codian Moon.]]
While [[Reek/Legends|reeks]] on the Codian Moon were originally [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]]<ref name="NEGAS" /> for [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]]<ref name="FF104">{{FactFile|104|GEO 11-12|Geonosis Arena Beasts}}</ref> and as pack [[Species/Legends|animals]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> unscrupulous [[Farmer/Legends|ranchers]],<ref name="DB" /> as well as members of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] species<ref name="Monster" /> that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> eventually discovered that<ref name="DB" /> a [[Diet/Legends|diet]] that included meat, coupled with periodic starving, heightened the reeks' aggression<ref name="NEGAS" /> and introduced carnivorous<ref name="DB" /> instincts in the creatures.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Facing plummeting profits and the diminishing of resources on the Codian Moon,<ref name="NEGAS" /> at some point by [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="24 BBY">{{DB|creature|reek|reek}} and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' establish that at some point, [[Farmer/Legends|ranchers]] on the Codian Moon started [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] and [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] [[Reek/Legends|reeks]] for use in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas. Furthermore, {{Film|II}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], depicts a reek being used in the [[Petranaki arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in such a way, and {{FactFile2014|73|GEO 21-26|Petranaki Arena}} confirms that specific creature's origin on the Codian Moon. Finally, {{FactFile|104|GEO 11-12|Geonosis Arena Beasts}} establishes that that reek had served in that capacity on Geonosis for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], meaning that the breeding of reeks for combat purposes must have begun by [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> several of the moon's ranchers began breeding<ref name="NEGAS" /> and [[Merchant/Legends|selling]]<ref name="DB" /> their reeks for use in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas<ref name="NEGAS" />&mdash;including<ref name="DB" /> the [[Petranaki arena]] on Geonosis,<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> where a reek from the Codian Moon<ref name="FF2014-73">{{FactFile2014|73|GEO 21-26|Petranaki Arena}}</ref> had served for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="FF104" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="24 BBY" />

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Codian Moon remained undecided on its affiliation to one of the opposing factions of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref> The population of the Codia [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered less than one million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA Codia" /> At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], the Codian Moon was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Locations==
The Codian Moon was known for<ref name="CSWE" /> the several [[Farm/Legends|ranches]] where reeks&mdash;large, [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]], [[Plant/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] world [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]&mdash;were often bred<ref name="NEGAS" /> after many herds of the creatures had been transplanted from the latter location.<ref name="FF104" /> Due to the resources,<ref name="DB" /> including [[Tree/Legends|wood]]-moss,<ref name="FF104" /> being scarcer on the Codian Moon than on Ylesia,<ref name="DB" /> the small herds of reeks on the moon<ref name="CVD">[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary'', 2006 edition]]</ref> displayed even greater territoriality<ref name="DB" /> over their chosen patches of wood-moss turf.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ep2VDcover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Codian Moon was introduced in ''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary''.]]
The Codian Moon was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was authored by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Ep2TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The moon's name was also spelled as "Codian moon" on one instance in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for the reek.<ref name="DB" />

The [[2006]] book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' claimed that the Codian Moon was a natural satellite of Ylesia.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Such placement directly contradicted the [[1997]] novel ''[[The Paradise Snare]]'', which explicitly notes that Ylesia had no moons,<ref name="Paradise">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> and also conflicted with prior sources placing the moon in the [[trailing]] direction from both the world [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside2">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref><ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and Ylesia in Hutt Space, on the opposite side of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="FF" /><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The information from ''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'' was definitively overridden by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the Codia system in grid square H-15, trailing from the [[Cerean system]],<ref name="TEA Codia" />&mdash;a placement that is in line with the information from the pre-2006 sources<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside2" /><ref name="CL" /> and was also repeated by later sources.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Mid Rim" /><ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
